title: Property classification and residences
content: Northstar Residences is a residential apartment tower, not an office building. Floors 3 through 9 contain Apartments 301 through 918, and Floor 10 contains six penthouse homes plus the shared sky lounge and roof terrace.
source: Northstar Residences Property Profile · Building classification · revised August 2026

title: Fitness center and pool hours
content: The resident fitness center and yoga studio are on Floor 2 and open daily from 5:00 AM to 11:00 PM. The indoor pool is open from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Residents must use their building access credential and guests must be accompanied.
source: Northstar Residences Handbook · Fitness and wellness amenities · revised August 2026

title: Northstar Café hours
content: Northstar Café is beside the main lobby on Floor 1. It is open from 6:30 AM to 8:00 PM Monday through Friday and from 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM on weekends.
source: Northstar Residences Handbook · Lobby services · revised August 2026

title: Move-ins and large deliveries
content: Furniture deliveries and resident move-ins use the service entrance between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM on weekdays and require a confirmed elevator reservation. Grocery and meal deliveries meet residents in the main lobby.
source: Northstar Residences Operations Manual · Move-ins and deliveries · revised August 2026

title: Apartment temperature policy
content: Apartment comfort controls may be adjusted between 68°F and 75°F. The operations agent may apply a reversible setpoint correction within that range; equipment repair or changes outside the range require facilities review.
source: Northstar Residences Energy and Comfort Policy · section 4.2

title: Resident visitor check-in
content: Visitors check in with the concierge in the main lobby and present photo identification. The resident receives an arrival notification and must confirm access before a temporary visitor pass is issued.
source: Northstar Residences Handbook · Visitors and access · revised August 2026

title: Parcel room collection
content: The secure parcel room is beside the lobby and is accessible to residents at all times with a building credential. Oversized or signature-required packages are released by the concierge between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.
source: Northstar Residences Handbook · Packages and parcel room · revised August 2026

title: Bicycle storage
content: Secure resident bicycle storage is on parking level P1 and is available at all times. Bicycle-room access must be enabled on the resident's building credential by the concierge.
source: Northstar Residences Handbook · Bicycle storage · revised August 2026

title: Resident lounges and roof terrace
content: The Floor 2 resident lounge is open daily from 6:00 AM to midnight without a reservation. The Floor 10 sky lounge and roof terrace are open from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM and require a resident reservation for private events.
source: Northstar Residences Handbook · Shared lounges · revised August 2026

title: Residential waste and recycling
content: Bagged household waste and separated recycling go into the labeled chutes in each floor's refuse room. Cardboard must be flattened and placed in the recycling area beside the service elevator; hazardous materials must be taken to the concierge.
source: Northstar Residences Operations Manual · Waste and recycling · revised August 2026
